context: Walk Her Home: to the bus terminal.

lines.speaker: char.tina_mercado
lines.text: You walk like a cop, Del. Shoulders back, eyes everywhere.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: A cop walks like he owns the street. I walk like I'm watching who does.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Goodnight. Lock the door. Count your money in the morning.
